name: SB 242084
summary: SB-242084 is a selective serotonin 5-HT2C receptor antagonist which is used in scientific research.

pharmacology.text: SB-242084 is a selective serotonin 5-HT2C receptor antagonist which is used in scientific research. It potentiates the hyperlocomotion induced by amphetamine, methylphenidate, cocaine, MDMA, fenfluramine, nicotine, and morphine in rodents.

uses.text: SB-242084 is a selective serotonin 5-HT2C receptor antagonist which is used in scientific research. SB-242084 was under development by GlaxoSmithKline for the treatment of anxiety disorders in the late 1990s.

fact.en: SB-242084 is a standard laboratory tool for blocking 5-HT2C receptors, which are involved in appetite, anxiety and the control of dopamine release.
fact.zh: SB-242084 是阻斷 5-HT2C 受體的標準實驗工具，這類受體與食慾、焦慮和多巴胺釋放的調控有關。
fact.zhHans: SB-242084 是阻断 5-HT2C 受体的标准实验工具，这类受体与食欲、焦虑和多巴胺释放的调控有关。
